dct_title_s: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) UAV imagery and GIS package by camp (March 2019)
dct_description_sm: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of March 2019 is based on [NPM Site Assessment 14](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-round-14-site-assessment) (as of 13 February 2019) and NPM UAV imagery (as of 23 January 2019). Here below, the complete package by camp: SW Map package KMZ file Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).
